# LLui

> A compile-time-optimized web framework built on The Elm Architecture (TEA), designed for LLM-first authoring. No virtual DOM — view() runs once at mount, building real DOM nodes with reactive bindings. State changes drive a chunked-mask reconciler: each binding carries a sparse mask of the dependency-path chunks it reads, and only the bindings whose paths actually changed re-commit.

## Packages

- @llui/dom@0.14.0 — LLui runtime — TEA component model, mount, scope tree, bindings, structural primitives, element helpers
- @llui/compiler@0.14.0 — LLui compiler engine — static analysis + emission. Build-tool-agnostic library consumed by @llui/vite-plugin.
- @llui/vite-plugin@0.12.2 — LLui compiler — Vite plugin for compile-time bitmask optimization, template cloning, and source maps
- @llui/compiler-ssr@0.13.1 — LLui compiler — SSR support (opt-in). 'use client' directive handling and SSR-specific emission paths consumed by @llui/vike.
- @llui/effects@0.3.0 — LLui effect builders — http, cancel, debounce, sequence, race, storage, broadcast
- @llui/components@0.19.0 — 66 headless UI components for LLui — accordion, dialog, tabs, select, tree-view, timer, tour, and more
- @llui/cli@0.2.0 — LLui CLI — add registry components (`llui add button`) to an LLui app, shadcn-style
- @llui/interactions@0.1.2 — Standalone DOM interaction primitives for focus, dismissal, positioning, modal isolation, and roving navigation
- @llui/router@0.12.1 — LLui router — named type-safe routes, Standard Schema codecs, history/hash mode
- @llui/transitions@0.12.1 — LLui animation helpers — transition(), fade, slide, scale, collapse for branch/show/each
- @llui/test@0.13.1 — LLui test harness — testComponent, testView, propertyTest, replayTrace, assertEffects
- @llui/vike@0.13.1 — LLui Vike SSR adapter — onRenderHtml, onRenderClient hooks
- @llui/security@0.2.1 — LLui shared security primitives — one canonical, dependency-free home for URL-scheme sanitization (sanitizeUrl) and loopback/same-origin recognition (CSRF/CSWSH gating), so security-sensitive logic can't drift between packages
- @llui/mcp@0.15.1 — LLui MCP server — LLM debug tools via Model Context Protocol
- @llui/agent@0.13.1 — LLui Agent — LAP server + browser client runtime for driving LLui apps from LLM clients
- llui-agent@0.11.2 — LLui Agent bridge — MCP server that translates Claude Desktop tool calls to LLui apps via LAP
- @llui/devmode-annotate@0.4.5 — LLui dev-mode HUD — drop annotated notes from the running app into the shared notebook for the LLM to consume
- @llui/devmode-annotate-editor@0.1.6 — Rich Markdown editor upgrade for the @llui/devmode-annotate HUD
- @llui/notes-format@0.2.1 — LLui devmode notebook on-disk format — zero-dependency note types, filename/slug/session helpers, and YAML (de)serialization shared by the vite-plugin server store, the HUD, and the MCP server
- @llui/a2ui@0.3.5 — LLui renderer for Google's A2UI protocol — render agent-driven UIs from A2UI envelopes onto the LLui signal runtime, reusing @llui/components headless primitives
- @llui/markdown@0.13.1 — LLui reactive Markdown rendering — parse to mdast, render real reactive DOM with custom per-node renderers and streaming-friendly keyed reuse
- @llui/markdown-editor@0.8.6 — WYSIWYG Markdown editor for LLui — hides Markdown behind a rich, pluggable editing widget built on Lexical
- @llui/lexical@0.5.1 — Low-level binding between Lexical and the LLui signal runtime — mount Lexical via foreign(), plugin contract, and the DecoratorNode ↔ LLui sub-view bridge
- @llui/lexical-collab@0.4.1 — Opt-in collaborative editing for the LLui ↔ Lexical binding — Yjs CRDT sync, scoped undo, and presence cursors over an injected provider
- @llui/lexical-loro@0.1.3 — Loro CRDT binding for the LLui ↔ Lexical editor — container schema, text-mark mapping, and concurrent-edit merging

## Example

```typescript
import { component, mountApp, div, button, text } from '@llui/dom'

type State = { count: number }
type Msg = { type: 'inc' } | { type: 'dec' }

const Counter = component<State, Msg, never>({
  name: 'Counter',
  init: () => [{ count: 0 }, []],
  update: (state, msg) => {
    switch (msg.type) {
      case 'inc': return [{ ...state, count: state.count + 1 }, []]
      case 'dec': return [{ ...state, count: state.count - 1 }, []]
    }
  },
  view: ({ state, send }) => [
    div({ class: 'counter' }, [
      button({ onClick: () => send({ type: 'dec' }) }, [text('-')]),
      text(state.map((s) => String(s.count))),
      button({ onClick: () => send({ type: 'inc' }) }, [text('+')]),
    ]),
  ],
})

mountApp(document.getElementById('app')!, Counter)
```
